description: Windows privacy and isolation tool with process protection, file access controls, and network filtering.
notes: Installer engine: Detect It Easy 3.21 identified this exact release asset as Inno Setup Module 6.3.0 in KiroBucket workflow run 41903467568. The downloaded file's SHA-256 matched the manifest and its Authenticode signature was Valid.
The manifest uses innosetup: true, so Scoop extracts the installer's {app} payload with innounp into the app directory; it does not run the vendor setup program.

Important limitation: extracting {app} does not execute the vendor [Run] actions. In particular, it does not run PrivacyAgent.exe -install, start the PrivacyAgent Windows service, install the bundled VC_redist.x64.exe, or run the optional ImDisk setup. The application therefore must not be considered fully installed or functionally verified with this extraction-only manifest.

MajorPrivacy depends on its service/kernel isolation component. Keep this manifest in under review until a Scoop-compatible, administrator-approved service and prerequisite setup/cleanup strategy is implemented and tested, including upgrade sequencing and removal of the service.
The x64 setup asset is used because the release inspected by the KiroBucket workflow was built as x64. No x86 or ARM64 package payload has been verified.
